name: Local Structure Example
description:
Adds a compact weathered stone shrine with a deterministic supply chest to newly generated Overworld terrain. Copy the complete 03_adv_18_local_structure folder into lua_scripts so its manifest, entrypoint, structure, and loot-table JSON stay together.

Explore new chunks and look for a broken cobblestone foundation surrounding a tall central pillar with a glowstone beacon. Roughly one in sixty-four chunks is eligible, and each eligible chunk tries up to four safe land positions before giving up. The shrine fits to solid terrain and uses a shallow rounded footprint with a bounded stepped foundation skirt. Craft a Shrine Surveyor from a compass and glowstone dust to find eligible chunks and their four candidate centers. Terrain conditions can still reject a candidate. Each shrine selects its transform, weathering, and chest contents deterministically.
